sourceTitle: Massacres of the South (1551-1815) Celebrated Crimes
description: "Massacres of the South" by Alexandre Dumas is a historical account written in the early 20th century, specifically around the 1910 era. The book examines the violent history of religious conflicts between Catholics and Protestants in the south of France from 1551 to 1815, detailing the bloodshed and chaos that marked this turbulent period.
